Report DescriptionNOAA/NESDIS MSPR ISSUED POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. REPORT DATE: 02-16-2024 REPORT TIME: 0045 UTC REGION: ATLANTIC SUB REGION: SOUTHEAST U.S. AREA/BLOCK: STRAITS OF FLORIDA 6853 IMAGE DATE: 02-15-2024 IMAGE TIME: 1549 UTC DATA SOURCE: LANDSAT8 MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 30 METER LOCATION: 27°14"22" N/79°54"38" W AREA: 1.85 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: HIGH REPORT MAP/GIS FILES: HTTPS://WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE OIL SLICK APPEARED TO ORIGINATE FROM THE SITE OF THE W.D. ANDERSON SHIPWRECK, BUT WAS SLIGHTLY DISCONNECTED. THE AREA MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 12.7NM IN LENGTH AND 0.1NM IN WIDTH. THE AREA WAS HARD TO IDENTIFY AND ENHANCE DUE TO CLOUD COVER IN THE AREA, ALTHOUGH IT DID APPEAR OUT OF PLACE. THE SLICK EXHIBITED A SMALL AREA OF RELATIVELY THICKER OIL THAT APPEARED LIGHTER COMPARED TO THE DARK SLICK SURROUNDING IT. WINDS AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGERY WERE FROM THE ESE AT APPROXIMATELY 15KTS. SINCE W.D. ANDERSON HAS BEEN A REPEAT LEAK SOURCE IN THE PAST, CONFIDENCE IN THIS REPORT IS HIGH. UNCERTAINTIES: THERE WERE PLENTY OF CLOUDS THAT OBSCURED THE AREA, SO THE FULL EXTENT OF THE OIL IS UNKNOWN.

properties.content:

Nearest City: Bayport, MN
Incident Type: UNKNOWN SHEEN
Material: UNKNOWN MATERIAL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
UNKNOWN SHEEN ON THE ST CROIX RIVER NEAR BAYPORT MINNESOTA. A LARGE AMOUNT OF POSSIBLE SOAP SUDS ARE VISIBLE IN THE WATER. THIS WAS OBSERVED AND PHOTOGRAPHED BETWEEN SUNNYSIDE MARINA AND HUDSON, WISCONSIN. ON 6/26 THE REPORTING PARTY REPORTED SOME OILY PATCHES IN THE WATER ON THE WISCONSIN SIDE. SEVERAL MORE HAVE BEEN OBSERVED SINCE THEN. NOW, THE OBSERVED CONDITIONS ARE PATCHES OF A TEARDROP SHAPED SUDSY FOAM ABOUT 20 FEET IN DIAMETER. THE PATCHES COVER 5% OF THE ENTIRE SURFACE OF THE RIVER, BANK TO BANK IN THE MILE WIDE POOL. THE REPORTING PARTY AND MEMBER OF THEIR CREW ARE FOR THE FIRST TIME GETTING SYMPTOMS OF SUSPECTED SWIMMER'S ITCH. NO REPORTS KNOWN OF SWIMMER'S ITCH IN 25 YEARS OF REGULAR BOATING IN THIS AREA. THE FOAM IS MADE OF 3 INCH LONG OVAL (NOT ROUND) PATCHES IN CLUSTERS. THE BUBBLES ARE TINY IT LOOKS MORE LIKE YEAST. THERE IS A SEWAGE TREATMENT PLANT JUST UPSTREAM OF THIS POOL AREA.

Report Description
THIS INCIDENT WAS REPORTED TO THE REPORTING PARTY AT 2123. CALLER STATES THAT THERE WAS A LOSS OF A RADIOGRAPHY CAMERA. THE CAMERA CONTAINS THE ISOTOPE IRIDIUM 192 WITH 13.4 CURIES. IT IS UNKNOWN HOW OR WHERE THE CAMERA WAS LOST. IT IS SUSPECTED TO HAVE BEEN LOST IN THE VICINITY OF ROBSTOWN, TX. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT IT MAY HAVE FALLEN OFF THE BACK OF A TRUCK. LOCAL LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COMPANY EMPLOYEES RETRACED THE PATH OF THE TRUCK FOR 3 MILES AND SEARCHED THE JOB SITE, BUT THE CAMERA WAS NOT LOCATED. IF AN INDIVIDUAL OPENED THE SHUTTER OF THE CAMERA THE EXPOSURE OF RADIATION IS POSSIBLE. IT IS A CATEGORY 3 SOURCE.

Report Description
****NOAA MARINE POLLUTION SURVEILLANCE REPORT**** THE OIL SLICK APPEARS TO BE COMING FROM THE DESTROYED TAYLOR SITE. THE SLICK IS 20.65 MILES IN LENGTH WITH A MAXIMUM WIDTH OF 1.4 MILES. SLICK ORIENTATION IS CONSISTENT WITH WINDS IN THE AREA. ALONG THE SOUTHEAST SIDE OF THE SLICK, THERE IS A LOT OF CONTAMINATION FROM NATURAL BIOGENIC FEATURES MAKING IT VERY DIFFICULT TO DETERMINE THE FULL EXTENT OF THE SURFACE OIL AND WAS NOT ANALYZED AS OIL. UNCERTAINTIES: THERE IS LOTS OF CONTAMINATION FROM NATURAL BIOGENIC TO THE SOUTHEAST OF THE SLICK. THIS MADE IT DIFFICULT TO DETERMINE WHAT WAS OIL AND WHAT WAS NOT. THIS WAS THE CAUSE OF WHY WE WENT WITH "MEDIUM-HIGH" INSTEAD OF "HIGH" FOR SLICK COMING FROM THE DESTROYED TAYLOR SITE. THE REANALYSIS OF THIS OIL SLICK SIGNATURE RESULTED IN A MUCH SMALLER AREA BELIEVED TO BE OIL FROM THE TAYLOR SITE GIVEN THE LARGE AREA OF BIOGENICS MENTIONED ABOVE.

Report DescriptionTHE CALLER IS REPORTING A RELEASE OF HOME HEATING OIL ONTO THE GROUND, AND INTO THE SOIL WITH A POTENTIAL RELEASE INTO THE CHENA RIVER, FROM A BELOW GROUND STORAGE TANK. THE CAUSE OF THE RELEASE IS UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME. THE CALLER STATES THAT THE COMPANY DELIVERED 907 GALLON TO THE RESIDENCE WHEN THEY WERE CALLED BACK TO THE RESIDENCE ABOUT A SMALL LEAK BUBBLING FROM THE FILL PIPE AT THE TOP OF THE TANK. THE AFTER HOUR MAINTENANCE RESPONDED TO FIND THE TANK STILL FULL WITH A SMALL RELEASE FROM THE FILL PIPE. THE CALLER STATES MAINTENANCE THEN RETURNED TO THE LOCATION ON THE MORNING OF 21NOV24 AT 1000 HRS TO FIND THE OIL LEVEL LOWER THAN EXPECTED. THE MAINTENANCE ON SCENE "DIPPED THE TANK" AND FOUND THE LEVEL WAS DOWN TO ABOUT THE 750 GALLONS LEVEL, REVEALING A RELEASE OF 250 GALLONS FROM AN UNKNOWN LOCATION ON THE TANK. THE CALLER STATES THAT A TEMPORARY TANK IS ENROUT TO ASSIST THE RESIDENCE, AND THE INVESTIGATION AND CLEAN-UP ARE UNDERWAY.

ORIGINAL REPORT SUMMARY: THE CANADIAN NATIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL EMERGENCY CENTER (NEEC) RECEIVED A REPORT FROM THE VERMONT DEC OF AN UNKNOWN SHEEN FROM AN UNKNOWN SOURCE ON THE WATERS OF LAKE WALLACE IN QUEBEC CANADA. THE LAKE CROSSES THE U.S AND CANADIAN BOARDER AS DOES THE SHEEN. AS OF RIGHT NOW THE SHEEN APPEARS TO BE MOSTLY ON THE CANADIAN SIDE, AND THE NEEC SUSPECTS THE SOURCE TO BE CANADIAN.

Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** THE FACILITY USES SODIUM HYPHCLORITE IS USED FOR BIOFOULING OF THE AUXILIARY COOLING WATER SYSTEM. THE FACILITY'S NPDES PERMIT ALLOWS FOR THE ADDITION OF SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE FOR A DURATION OF 2 HOURS PER DAY AND HAS A LIMIT ON TOTAL RESIDUAL CHLORINE AT THE OUTFALL. ON 8/21/2013 MAINTENANCE WORK WAS PERFORMED ON THE SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE SYSTEM AND THE PUMP USED TO DELIVER THE MATERIAL WAS ACCIDENTLY LEFT ON IN MANUAL MODE DRAINING A 400 GALLON TANK AND EXCEEDING THE CERCAL RQ. PH LOGS AT THE NPDES DISCHARGE SHOW A SPIKE IN PH FROM 12:00 PM - 18:30 ON 8/21/2013 WHERE PH PEAKED AT 7.4 FROM A BACKGROUND LEVEL OF 6.8-7.0. A FEW DEAD FISH (BLUEGILL AND BULLHEAD) HAVE BEEN IDENTIFIED.
